usd.first: OpenUSD compiled into a RISC-V sandbox guest that opens a stage from bytes, with the probe guest that first proved it could.

drape.description: The drape stage as a godot-sandbox guest: AVBD cloth from Lean kernels on the CPU and on RenderingDevice
drape.first: The drape stage as a godot-sandbox guest: AVBD cloth from Lean kernels, run on the CPU and on RenderingDevice.

cloth-fit.description: The cloth-fit stage as a godot-sandbox guest whose compute runs on the GPU (no CPU path)
cloth-fit.first: The cloth-fit stage as a godot-sandbox guest whose compute runs on the GPU: a garment is retargeted onto a new body without intersections.

garment-fit.description: The fit stage as a godot-sandbox guest: cloth-fit's PolyFEM garment solve with the Lean SDF sampler
garment-fit.first: The garment fit stage as a godot-sandbox guest: an intersection-free retargeting solve with a signed-distance sampler emitted from Lean.

headfit.description: The head fit as a godot-sandbox guest: the ANNY head fit and the unified-expression transfer
headfit.first: The head fit as a sandboxed guest program: it fits the parametric body model's head and transfers a shared facial-expression set onto it.

skintokens.first: SkinTokens auto-rigging on ggml-rd, built as a sandboxed guest program. The host passes it a mesh and the model's weights, and it returns the rigged model as a GLB.

skintokens-rig.description: Godot host that runs the SkinTokens rig guest on WebGPU, Vulkan or Metal
skintokens-rig.first: A small Godot 4 project that runs the SkinTokens rig guest, `skintokens.elf`, on Godot's RenderingDevice. It rigs one GLB file and writes the rigged GLB.

pixal3d.description: Pixal3D (image to 3D) as a godot-sandbox guest ELF on ggml-rd
pixal3d.first: Pixal3D (image to 3D, a TRELLIS.2 pipeline) as a godot-sandbox guest ELF whose ggml graph runs on ggml-rd.

remesh.description: meshoptimizer's voxel remesher and simplifier as a godot-sandbox guest, the remesh stage of RFD 2284
remesh.first: A remesher, simplifier and level-of-detail builder for avatar meshes that runs as a sandbox guest and works on flat arrays.

cage.description: The cage stage as a godot-sandbox guest: the (1,3) biharmonic bind and the in-motion cage fit on L-BFGS-B
cage.first: The cage stage as a godot-sandbox guest: the (1,3) biharmonic bind and the in-motion cage fit on L-BFGS-B.

seethrough.description: See-Through (anime illustration to inpainted layers + depth) as a godot-sandbox guest on ggml-rd
seethrough.first: See-Through (anime illustration -> inpainted semantic layers + depth) as a godot-sandbox guest ELF whose ggml graph runs on ggml-rd.
